conversion: card-hours weighted by throughput multiples fixed before the study from published card specifications (relative to an H200); not measured on our workload; 12.1 card-hours on cards without a multiple left out

local.card_hours_definition: Card-hours: on each card, every moment is shared equally among the logged intervals (training, fidelity or evaluation lanes) that held the card then, so a card's card-hours sum to the time it was busy with logged work; lane-hours are the intervals' own lengths.

rented.no_result_rule: pods that ran no job, and evaluation pods whose job was not fetched and checked (setup and equivalence-check failures, a refused card, jobs past their planned end, a terminated pod)

not_counted: local evaluation jobs before the audit worker's log began, whose card no log records
reinforcement learning run locally, whose card is not recorded
the engine time of threshold building and of reinforcement learning's engine-side phases
the second machine's processor time outside the engine pool
card-hours on cards without a throughput multiple
